candidates.name: SHOCK_BREAKOUT_CONTINUATION
candidates.hypothesis: leaving the shock range by a meaningful margin says the flow that made the shock is not finished; the breakout names the direction, the event does not

verdict_rules.rule: OOS VIP0_BASE net mean > 0 and 95% CI lower bound > 0
sample gate satisfied: events >= 200, confirmed trades >= 60, 5 years, evaluable folds >= 5
judgeable folds: gross>0 in >= 2/3, net>0 in >= 1/2
no single trade > 20% of total net sum

detail.note: the coin-flip test: confirmation must do better than chance at surviving its own structural stop
